description: Capivasertib plus fulvestrant is recommended as an option for treating hormone receptor (HR)-positive HER2-negative (defined as immunohistochemistry [IHC]0 or IHC1 positive, or IHC2 positive and in situ hybridisation [ISH]1 negative) locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer in adults that has 1 or more PIK3CA, AKT1 or PTEN gene alterations and has recurred or progressed after a cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) 4 and 6 inhibitor plus an aromatase inhibitor.

extensions.value: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended capivasertib plus fulvestrant as an option for treating hormone receptor (HR)-positive HER2-negative (defined as immunohistochemistry [IHC]0 or IHC1 positive, or IHC2 positive and in situ hybridisation [ISH]1 negative) locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer in adults that has 1 or more PIK3CA, AKT1 or PTEN gene alterations and has recurred or progressed after a cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) 4 and 6 inhibitor plus an aromatase inhibitor. Capivasertib is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
